title: Remove unrelated full-payload hydration from canonical runtime-summary enrichment
summary: Fixes canonical runtime-summary enrichment timeout and HTTP 500 by skipping already-enriched summaries before collecting event IDs, and querying only the canonical position_snapshot and reconciliation_completed/failed evidence required by the existing selector via an optional event_types filter in build_postgres_event_reader. Unrelated lifecycle payloads (order_submitted, order_filled, heartbeats) are excluded at the database layer instead of hydrating thousands of full JSON payloads. Retains generic accepted/observed pair behavior, original 5.0s deadlines, positive DB sequence validation, explicit paper/live boundaries, and complete finite numeric metrics from the same snapshot without loss of second bindings or older eligible positions.
